questions.q: A ladder leans against a wall, making an angle of $62°$ with the ground. The foot of the ladder is $4.5$ m from the base of the wall. How high up the wall does the ladder reach? Round to two decimal places.
From the top of a cliff 50 m above sea level, the angle of depression to a boat is $18°$. How far is the boat from the base of the cliff? Round to one decimal place.
A kite string is 85 m long and makes an angle of $54°$ with the horizontal ground. Assuming the string is straight, find the height of the kite above the ground, to the nearest metre.

Two buildings are 40 m apart. From the top of the shorter building (height 25 m), the angle of elevation to the top of the taller building is $32°$. Find the height of the taller building, to one decimal place.
questions.answer: Rise $= 40\tan 32° \approx 40(0.6249) \approx 25.0$ m, so the taller building is about $25 + 25.0 = 50.0$ m.

questions.q: A surveyor stands 120 m from the base of a tower and measures the angle of elevation to the top as $37°$. Find the height of the tower, to the nearest tenth of a metre.

In right triangle $PQR$ with the right angle at $R$, the two legs are $PR = 9$ and $QR = 12$. Find angle $P$ (opposite $QR$) to the nearest tenth of a degree, and the length of the hypotenuse.

A drone hovers at a height of 60 m. The angle of depression from the drone to a landmark on the ground is $27°$. Find the horizontal distance from the point directly below the drone to the landmark, to the nearest metre.

From a lighthouse 45 m tall, the angle of depression to a ship is $12°$, and a second ship is spotted further out with angle of depression $7°$. Find the distance between the two ships, to the nearest metre.
questions.answer: Distances from the base: $d_1 = \frac{45}{\tan 12°}\approx 211.7$ m; $d_2 = \frac{45}{\tan 7°}\approx 366.5$ m. Distance between ships $\approx 366.5-211.7\approx 154.8$ m.
